PrintLogo.Description: Print the GUILDA logo at startup

UpdateKeyMap.Description: Update the model key map at startup: 'none' (do not update), 'silent' (update without printing) or 'disp' (update and print the keys)

DeveloperPath.Description: Add the developer folder _GUILDAsystem/_admin to the MATLAB path (scripts for developers, such as those that draw the figures of the documentation). Applied by GUILDA.addpath, which runs at startup
